files.description: TouchWorks EHI Export Definition v2026.1 — ZIP containing HTML documentation site with full database schema: 8 databases, 577 tables, 7748 columns with data types, descriptions, foreign keys, and indexes. This is the primary (b)(10) EHI export documentation.

Extracted contents of TWEHR-2026.1 ZIP. Contains tree.html (navigation), main.html (frameset), and 577 individual table HTML pages under Touchworks/User_databases/*/Tables/. Each page documents a database table with columns, data types, foreign keys, indexes, and descriptions.

Enrichment output: structured JSON array of all 577 tables extracted from the HTML documentation. Each entry contains database, schema, tableName, description, columns (with data types, nullability, descriptions, FK targets), foreignKeys, and indexes. Machine-queryable replacement for the HTML pages.
Enrichment output: parsing statistics — total files discovered (600), table files (577), parse success rate (100%), per-database table counts, and column description coverage (51.3%).
Enrichment script: Bun TypeScript script that parses all HTML table documentation pages and extracts structured table/column metadata into tables.json and coverage.json. Deterministic and rerunnable.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
